query:
SELECT m.id, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company, m.timeSlot, s.companyName
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
JOIN delegateProfiles dp ON dp.attendeeId = m.attendeeId
WHERE m.id = 663387;
